maya: Quick sync — several customers (FinCo, MedAI, Searchly) pushed back on our current JSON-mode tradeoffs. They want deterministic schemas, clear retry semantics, and a path for function/tool calling responses that still validate. Need to lock launch criteria + timeline by EOD Friday.

ben: +1. Can we list concrete metrics for sign-off? what do we need to measure to say 'ship'? :eyes:

jordan: Proposal: acceptance metrics = 1) schema-pass-rate >= 98% on our eval sets, 2) median 95th-latency delta vs current freeform < 40ms, 3) token cost delta < 5% for typical prompts, 4) per-customer opt-out toggles.

katie: Also need safety/QA checks for function calling: sometimes tools return blobs that don't map to schema. We should define a fallback: either auto-retry with relaxed schema or return structured error to caller.

maya: +1 to those metrics. For fallback options I sketched three modes: strict (no responses unless valid), best-effort (auto-repair + single retry), and permissive (return text payload + warning). We should support per-route config.

ben: Can we show a minimal config example for the platform API? helps engineering and customers.

jordan: here's a sketch:```json
{"validation_mode":"strict","retry_policy":{"max_attempts":1,"backoff_ms":200,"fallback_to_text":false},"function_calling":{"validate_tool_output":true,"tool_validation_mode":"best-effort"}}
```

katie: For canary plan: start with 1% traffic to strict validation, monitor schema-pass-rate and error-budget, then 5%, 20%, 50% over two weeks. If pass-rate < 98% at any stage rollback to previous model/route.

maya: Launch checklist items (draft):
- API surface: chat/completions + embeddings unaffected, structured-output flag + schema param added
- Request-level fields: `schema` (json-schema), `validation_mode` (strict|best-effort|permissive), `retry_policy` (max_attempts, backoff_ms)
- Telemetry: per-request schema result, repair attempts, validation latency, token delta
- Evals: canonical prompt sets for top 10 customers + synthetic edge cases
- Docs: clear behavior matrix and migration guide
- Admin UI: per-tenant default + per-route override

ben: Ops concerns: strict mode will increase 4xx/500 visible to customers if we return validation errors. We need standardized error codes and SDK helpers to surface repairs and suggested retries.

jordan: SDKs will include helpers: `validateOrRepair(schema)` and `onValidationError: enum['retry','use_text','raise']`. Also add server-side repair logs for audit.

katie: Customer asks: MedAI wants guaranteed structured summary for billing reports (strict). FinCo wants best-effort with audit trail (repair logs + original_text). Searchly prefers permissive as they post-process. We need per-tenant defaults asap.

maya: Timeline ask: engineering needs final scope by Friday to hit early May beta. If we delay, push to June. Can eng estimate effort for strict validation + retry + telemetry?

ben: Rough eng guesses: core validation plumbing (2w), repair/retry orchestration (1w), telemetry + SDK changes (1w), docs + migrations (1w). So 5w total. Can prioritize minimal beta: best-effort + telemetry in 3w, then strict mode in follow-up.

jordan: Risk notes: repair heuristics may introduce hallucinated fields. We must track 'repaired' flag in response and include provenance (model-repaired vs tool-sourced).

katie: Launch gating rule suggestion: do not GA strict mode until any single repair heuristic has <0.5% detrimental changes on human evals.

maya: Agreement: ship best-effort beta with per-tenant toggles + telemetry. Hold strict GA until additional evals and canary passes. I'll compile customer ask matrix and update roadmap doc.

release-bot: Deployment note: canary experiment plumbing scheduled on staging for 2025-05-02 22:00 UTC.

ben: Next step: maya will share a short PRD with the acceptance metrics + sample API payloads. Eng to confirm implementation plan tomorrow.

maya: Thanks — I'll post PRD and customer matrix in this thread by 16:00 today. ``
